subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.

Propel

Paddles are used to ________ the boat.
solution:
The correct answer is **'move'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'Propel' typically means to drive or push something forwards. (धकेलना).

 
 
• Example: The wind propelled the leaves along the street.
 
 
 
• The synonym 'Move' also signifies changing position or place.(हिलना).
 
 
• Example: Try to move the car out of the mud.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Move'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1:** "Rush"** means to move with urgent haste (जल्दबाजी करना).
 
• Option 3: **"Carry"** means to take or support from one place to another (उठाना).
 
• Option 4: **"Run"** means to move at a speed faster than a walk (दौड़ना).
